arms.name: random_ema
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

ema.update: after every optimizer step, EMA=0.95*EMA+0.05*current parameter; initialize from the first updated parameters
ema.evaluation: evaluate only the final averaged parameters, with no intermediate EMA checkpoint selection or decay sweep
ema.equal_opportunity: identical decay, update rule, final evaluation, and per-parameter cost for every arm
ema.deployment: ordinary dense inference using the averaged weights

validation.no_reproduction_gate: EMA is part of the new development method; raw final weights are secondary and are not substituted for the frozen EMA endpoint

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated formula as the 87.5% experiment; dense pays full forward/backward cost
cost_accounting.ema_aux: two estimated operations per model parameter per step, added to every arm's total
cost_accounting.ema_evaluation: reported separately and excluded from training cost for every arm
cost_accounting.final_evaluation: identical newly generated held-out batches for every arm

primary_endpoint: final EMA ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-EMA cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs EMA loss is not below random EMA loss despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs EMA beats random but not dense EMA; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs EMA loss is below both random and dense EMA while its total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: sweeping EMA decay on this development result
evaluating EMA only for the sparse arm
changing steps, decay, or evaluation after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level EMA win
